# 236 # Extension Must Be Active: none
# Many important RISC-V extensions are currently active.
# Test Case Name: mstatus
# Test Case Type: REGISTER
# Test Case Rule: RULE 154: If the current privilege mode has less privilege than M-mode, an interrupt i will trap to M-mode, causing the privilege mode to change to M-mode regardless of the MIE bit in mstatus.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x0
csrw mstatus, t0 # Clear MIE (bit 3) and set MPP (bits 11-12) to 00 (U-mode)
li t0, 0x800 # Set MPP to 01 (S-mode)
csrs mstatus, t0
mret # Transition to S-mode. Now current privilege < M-mode.
# Result: Privilege mode changes to M-mode.

# 262 # Extension Must Be Active: NONE
# Many important RISC-V extensions are currently active.
# Test Case Name: mstatus
# Test Case Type: REGISTER
# Test Case Rule: RULE 184: When the V bit is 0, the vsatp register does not directly affect the behavior of the machine unless a virtual-machine load/store or the MPRV feature in the mstatus register is used to execute a load or store as though V is 1.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x0
csrw mstatus, t0 # V=0, MPRV=0
li t1, 0x80000000 # Set vsatp MODE to Sv39 (simplified)
csrw vsatp, t1 # vsatp is now configured
li t2, 0x20000 # MPRV bit is 17
csrs mstatus, t2 # Set MPRV=1
